change: Reject recursive general event-loop entry and entry from live owner-thread FFI callbacks before isolate registration or dequeueing work. Keep existing pending exception intact.
limitations: This is a refusal guard, not nested/modal event-turn support.
No realtime audio kernel or foreign-thread realtime callback guarantee.

coverage: Queued microtasks and timers unchanged on rejection
CURRENT and MESSAGE_ROOT preserved through forced collection
Caught refusal allows the outer loop to continue in tracing and ARC
FFI normal/exceptional exit balances nested owner callback depth
Late/listener/foreign synchronous entries do not change owner depth
Independent nested finalization frames keep their roots alive
